name: RED AXS braze-on front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed reference for the standard twelve-speed RED AXS E1 double front derailleur: braze-on, with wedge, mounting bolt and washer, without battery or a separate clamp adapter. This is the standard-chainline reference, not a Wide assembly.
